subject: Request: SOC2 Type II + keystore rotation & privileged-access samples for Novus
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <audit@novushealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 Type II and supplemental artifacts request (Novus)

Hi Rafael,

We are kicking off our internal procurement security review for Novus Health and need a copy of Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report covering the 2026 audit period. In addition to the report, procurement has asked for a short bridge letter if the report's period does not cover our contract start date.

Separately, our security team has a few follow-ups beyond the report that they need to validate controls for their architecture review:
- MFA enforcement evidence for interactive logins (policy + recent enforcement logs)
- Keystore/CMK rotation records (proof of rotation + who approved)
- Privileged account deprovisioning snapshot for terminated admins (sample exports)
- A one-week slice of authN/authZ logs (timestamps + anonymized user ids) from the last 12 months

Can you confirm whether you can provide these artifacts (or narrow scoped extracts) and an expected delivery date? If you prefer, we can accept redacted/sampled CSVs for the logs.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Sharma
Security & Compliance Manager
Novus Health

--

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II and supplemental artifacts request (Novus)

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter if the report period ends before your contract start. For the supplemental artifacts:

- MFA: we can export policy screenshots and an enforcement log slice (anonymized);
- Keystore rotations: we have rotation records and approver attestations (HSM-backed where applicable);
- Privileged deprovisioning: we can provide a sampled snapshot of admin removals and the change ticket references;
- Auth logs: we can produce a 7-day slice with hashed identifiers and redacted IPs.

Proposed timeline: SOC2 + bridge letter by EOD Wed (2027-02-17), artifact bundle (logs + rotation CSVs) by Thu (2027-02-18) EOD. If you need anything sooner or need different redaction rules, tell us and we'll adjust.

I'll coordinate delivery from our security team (cc'd: Olga) and infrastructure (cc'd: Karthik) for the keystore material. We will share a Drive link and a short manifest of all files.

Best,
Rafael
VP, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachment: acceptance-plan.txt (text)
From: Priya Sharma <audit@novushealth.com>

Cc: Novus Health Security Team <security@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:47:22 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II and supplemental artifacts request (Novus)

Thanks Rafael — timeline looks good. A few clarifications from our security reviewers to make sure the artifacts will be usable for our control mapping:

1) For MFA: we need a statement of how MFA is enforced (policy + enforcement scope: e.g., console, API tokens, admin UIs) and a sample of last 90 days of auth events showing the MFA factor used. Redact user identifiers but keep timestamps and event types.
2) Keystore: rotation evidence should include the rotation dates, the key identifiers (partial ok), and the approver (name + role). If HSM attestations exist, please include them.
3) Privileged deprovisioning: we only need a 30-day snapshot around one removal event (ticket id, who approved, before/after role assignment) for three deprovisioned admins.
4) Logs: 7-day authN/authZ slice is fine — please hash principals and remove any customer PII.

Also note that Novus requires a signed bridge letter if the SOC 2 report period ends before 2027-03-01.

If you can provide the artifacts as zipped CSVs plus a short manifest and bridge letter draft, we can fast-track procurement.

Regards,
Priya

--
